name: SCHUMAG Aktiengesellschaft
summary: SCHUMAG Aktiengesellschaft produces and sells various components in Germany. The company's precision components include automotive vendor parts, such as control pistons, valve pistons, plungers, valve needles, valve bodies, valve balls, pump pistons, inductors, high-pressure stops, armature axles, valve bushes, steering shafts, control axles, valve shafts, drive shafts, planet pinions, pistons, piston rods, torsion bars, and stops. Its precision components also comprise small parts; assembly parts, including plunger barrel combinations, high-pressure relief valves, hydraulic valves, plunger sleeve combinations, and injection valves; and classical program products consisting of transmission shafts, drive pins, chopping shafts, pins, bolts, axles, meter axles, indicator axles, and upper bearing needles. The company also provides standard components, such as ejectors, core pins, ejector pins and sleeves, guiding elements, tapered interlocks, sprue bushings, and other components; and non-standard components. It also exports its products to approximately 20 countries worldwide. The company was founded in 1830 and is based in Aachen, Germany. SCHUMAG Aktiengesellschaft is a subsidiary of Meibah International GmbH.
